name: Ikhanda elibuhlungu ne-migraine
tagline: Iningi aliyona ingozi. Abanye bakhona. Yazi izimpawu.

urgent.heading: Hamba esibhedlela manje uma
urgent.primary_message: Iningi lekhanda elibuhlungu aliyona ingozi. Kodwa izimpawu ezithile eziyisixwayiso zingasho isifo sohlangothi, ukopha kobuchopho, noma i-meningitis. Ungalindi — hamba.

what_is_it.heading: Ikhanda elibuhlungu kanye ne-migraine ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Iningi lekhanda elibuhlungu yikhanda elicindezelayo - okubangelwa imisipha eqinile, ukucindezeleka, ukuphelelwa amandla kwamanzi, noma ukulala kabi. I-Migraine ihlukile - isimo semizwa lapho ubuchopho buba nomuzwa ojulile, ngokuvamile kube nobuhlungu obukhulu, isicanucanu, nokuzwela ukukhanya nomsindo.
paragraphs: Ikhanda elibuhlungu lizwakala njengebhande eliqinile elizungeze ikhanda, nhlangothi zombili, libuthuntu futhi lizinzile. I-Migraines ngokuvamile ishaya ohlangothini olulodwa, igcine amahora angu-4-72, futhi ikuphoqe ukuba ulale phansi ekamelweni elimnyama. Ikhanda elibuhlungu leqembu alivamile - linamandla, lifushane, lizungeze iso elilodwa.

Iningi lekhanda elibuhlungu lixazulula ngokuphumula, uketshezi, namaphilisi ezinhlungu alula. Izinhlungu zekhanda ezivamile noma ezinzima zidinga udokotela - hhayi ukuze athole isimila (lokhu akuvamile) kodwa ukuthola ukwelashwa okungcono kunalokho onakho njengamanje. I-Migraine ikakhulukazi inezokwelapha eziningi ezisebenzayo abantu abangazi ngazo.

items.headline: Okujwayelekile kakhulu
items.body: Cishe i-12% yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika bane-migraine. Ikhanda elibuhlungu lithinta cishe wonke umuntu ngezikhathi ezithile.

items.headline: Kuyalapheka
items.body: I-Migraine inokwelashwa okusebenzayo - kokubili ukumisa ukuhlaselwa kanye nokukuvimbela. Uma eyakho ingalawulwa kahle, kukhona izinketho ezingcono.

items.headline: Ukusetshenziswa ngokweqile kwe-Painkiller
items.body: Ukuphuza amaphilisi ezinhlungu alula ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezingu-2-3 ngesonto kungabangela ubuhlungu bekhanda obukhulu. Khuluma nodokotela ngalokhu - okuvamile futhi kuyalapheka.

items.headline: Ikakhulukazi hhayi serious
items.body: Izimila ebuchosheni nezimbangela ezingathi sína azivamile. Amafulegi abomvu ngenhla aphawula ukuthi kufanele ukhathazeke nini - kukho konke okunye, akulungile ngaso sonke isikhathi.

pull_quote.text: I-migraine ayiyona nje 'ikhanda elibuhlungu'. Isenzakalo sezinzwa esingashiya umuntu engakwazi ukusebenza, ukushayela, noma ukunakekela izingane amahora noma izinsuku. Idinga ukwelashwa kwangempela.

signs.heading: Ebahlukanisa
signs.lede: Izinhlungu zekhanda ezehlukene zisabela ekwelashweni okuhlukene - ukukhomba eyakho kukusiza ukuthi ulaphe.

items.title: Ikhanda elibuhlungu
items.description: Ibhande eliqinile elizungeze ikhanda, izinhlangothi zombili, libuthuntu futhi lizinzile. Okumaphakathi kuya kokumaphakathi. Akukho ukucanuzela kwenhliziyo. Ngokuvamile kusukela ekucindezelekeni, ukungalali kahle, ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni, ukucindezelwa kwamehlo, noma ukuma kabi.

items.title: I-Migraine
items.description: Ubuhlungu obuhlabayo ngokuvamile ohlangothini olulodwa, buphakathi kuya kobunzima. Ngokuvamile kuba nesicanucanu, ukuhlanza, ukukhanya nomsindo. Ihlala amahora angu-4-72. Ingase ilandele i-visual aura (ama-zigzag, indawo eyimpumputhe).

items.title: Ikhanda le-Cluster
items.description: Kungazelelwe, ubuhlungu obukhulu, bokubhoboza eduze kweso elilodwa. Ukuchelela amehlo, ukuminyana kwekhala ngakolunye uhlangothi. Kafushane (imizuzu engu-15 - amahora angu-3) kodwa ukuhlaselwa kaningi ngosuku amasonto. Idinga ukwelashwa okukhethekile.

items.fact: I-Migraine yisimo sezinzwa esihlanganisa izinguquko ekusebenzeni kukagesi ebuchosheni, ukugeleza kwegazi, nokuvuvukala. Ikhanda elibuhlungu liwuphawu kwabaningi. Kuyafaneleka ukuthathwa ngokungathi sína.

items.myth: Uma amaphilisi ezinhlungu engasizi, akukho okuzosiza.
items.fact: Ukwelashwa okuqondene ne-Migraine - ama-triptan, ama-gepant, nokunye - kusebenza lapho amaphilisi ezinhlungu ajwayelekile engasebenzi. Imithi yokuvimbela ingakwazi ukusika imvamisa ye-migraine ngesigamu. Buza udokotela wakho.

Izimila zobuchopho azivamile futhi ngokuvamile zibangela amaphethini athile - kubi kakhulu ekuseni, ukuhlanza, izimpawu zemizwa. Izinhlungu zekhanda ezivame kakhulu yi-migraine, ukucindezeleka, noma ukusebenzisa imithi ngokweqile - hhayi isimila.
I-Migraine ithinta abantu babo bonke ubulili. Ukuyiziba akukwenzi kube nemizwa encane. Ukwelashwa kukhona - ukukusebenzisa kunengqondo, akubuthakathaka.

items.title: Ngekhanda elicindezelayo ngezikhathi ezithile
items.description: I-Paracetamol noma ibuprofen njengoba iqondiswa. I-Hydrate. Phumula ekamelweni elithule nelilufifi. Izibangeli zekheli — ukulala, isikhathi sesikrini, ingcindezi, ukuxineka kwamehlo.

items.title: Nge-migraine - thatha isinyathelo kusenesikhathi
items.description: Thatha ukukhululeka kobuhlungu futhi uphumule ngokushesha nje lapho ubona ukuthi i-migraine iqala. I-Triptans (sumatriptan) isebenza kangcono kakhulu esibonakalisweni sokuqala kunalapho ubuhlungu buphakama. Khuluma nomtholampilo mayelana nezinketho zemithi.

items.title: Gcina idayari yekhanda
items.description: Idethi, isikhathi, uhlobo, ubukhali, yini esize, izingcuphe ezingaba khona. Izinyanga ezimbili zamanothi zizobonisa amaphethini. Letha idayari kudokotela - iwusizo kakhulu kunokuchaza ngekhanda.

items.title: Uma uphuza amaphilisi ezinhlungu izinsuku eziningi - bonana nodokotela
items.description: Ikhanda elibuhlungu elisetshenziswa ngokweqile livamile futhi liyabuyiselwa emuva. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ukwelashwa ukumisa isibulali-zinhlungu. Udokotela angakusiza ukuthi wenze lokhu ngokuphepha.

items.title: Uma kuvela amafulegi abomvu - yiya esibhedlela
items.description: Ikhanda elibuhlungu kungazelelwe, ikhanda elibuhlungu/ukuqina kwentamo/ukuqubuka, ikhanda elibuhlungu nokudideka noma ubuthakathaka — lokhu kudinga ukuhlolwa okuphuthumayo.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Iningi lekhanda elibuhlungu lingalawuleka ezingeni lasemtholampilo. Izinzuzo ze-migraine eziphikelelayo ekudlulisweni kwe-neurology - kutholakala ngohlelo lomphakathi.

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Ukuhlolwa kwamahhala, ama-painkiller, kanye ne-migraine kadokotela
helplines.meta: Akukho ukuqokwa · alukho usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo

helplines.name: Noma yiliphi ikhemisi lendawo
helplines.description: I-paracetamol ne-ibuprofen etholakala ngaphandle kwekhawunta ukuze isetshenziswe ngezikhathi ezithile
